title: Na deys apna hai
body:
Na deys apna hai
Karbala se chali eik bekas behen.
Bhaayi se aalam-e-gurbat watan yaad aya.
Sab shaheedo ko kehti huwi alvida.
Bhaayi ki laash pe pohnchi to kafan yaad aya.
Khud ko naake se giraakar Zainab kehne lagi roro kar.
<<MINI>>
Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye dekh zara ay tashnadahan, shaano to mere jakre hai rasan, Aur uspe sitam hai, sar par nahi chadar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal saath tere har ghaam chali, ab qaydi huwi aur shaam chali, is dard ke maare roti hu khule sare, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba hai ameer-e-auno mada, hai tera laqab sardar-e-jinaa, zainab ko huwi hai bechadar beghar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay bhaayi teri ghurbat ki kasam, ta mard nahi bhulungi ye gham, pardes mei aakar, na khaa hai labo par, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya zulm sahe tujh ko hai khabar, hai aun-o-muhammad khaak basar, ab tumse nahi hai, paani bhi mayassar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hota jo madina bhaayi mere, miljaata kafan mazloom tujhe, is dasht-e-bala mei, majboor hai khwaahar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai kushta-e-tegh-e-zulm bata, jab koi mera yawar na raha, maqtool-e-jafaa hai, abbas aur akbar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kya na huwi zainab pe jafaa, sab khayme jale asbaab luta, par sab se baraa hai, ye gham mere dil par, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Irfan aur Mazhar kehna sake, jo bint-e-ali ne bayn kiyey, phat'ta hai kaleja, is baat ko sunkar, Mei kaise kafan du mere mazloom baraadar
<<MINI>>
(Na deys apna hai, na log apne hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
As-salaam alayka ya Sayyed-o-shuhadaa
